perks.name: Untold Greed
perks.description: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
perks.exact:
Upon picking up an Ammo Brick, an Orb of Power, on Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Grants a stack of Untold Greed, up to a maximum of 100 stacks.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Removes 10 stacks.

Untold Greed:
Up to +? Reload Speed and 15% Damage Resist at x25 stacks.
x5 = 6% DR | x10 = 9% DR | x15 = 11% DR | x20 = 13% DR | x25+ = 15% DR

perks.name: Overflowing Coffers
perks.description: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
perks.exact:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Elemental Pickups are massively improved.
No discernible effect on Orbs of Power.

Firesprites (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Grenade Energy
Ionic Traces (+100% Class, +85% Grenade/Melee) | 11.25% Grenade/Melee + 13.5% Class -> 21% Grenade/Melee + 27% Class + 2% Super
Void Breaches (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Class Energy
Stasis Shards (+260%) | 10% -> 36% Melee Energy. Additive to Hunger's +60%, totalling 42.5% Energy per pickup.
Strand Tangles | 350% increased damage. Affects Whirling Maelstrom too!

Upon reaching Critical Health while having x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.
The Orbs of Power are ejected in front of the user at high speeds, likely clipping inside walls.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.

item.name: Reaper
item.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.

item.name: Proximity Ward
item.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher.
item.exact:
During a Finisher:
Grants a 200 HP Overshield.

item.name: Special Finisher
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
On Finisher:
Consumes x3 Armor Charge.

Generates a Special Ammo Brick for the user and allies.
